mapper.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.next_code) < 6 THEN LPAD(t.next_code, 6, '0') ELSE t.next_code END FROM ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(code AS NUMERIC)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR) AS next_code FROM products WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(code, '^[0-9]+$') ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( code, name, spec, storage, client_code, product_type, reg_user_id, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{storage}, #{clientCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productType}, #{regUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO pricing ( product_code, product_name, spec, product_type, client_name, material_cost, loss_cost, loss_rate, markup_cost, markup_rate, labor_cost, packaging_cost, logistics_cost, margin, other_cost1, other_cost1_note, other_cost2, other_cost2_note, other_cost3, other_cost3_note, other_cost4, other_cost4_note, current_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{productType}, #{clientName}, #{materialCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lossCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lossRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{markupCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{markupRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{laborCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{packagingCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{logisticsCost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{margin,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost1,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost1Note}, #{otherCost2,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost2Note}, #{otherCost3,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost3Note}, #{otherCost4,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{otherCost4Note}, #{currentPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{totalPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE} )
